#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    int count = 0;
    if (!s.empty()) {
        std::regex re("(?<=(.))(?!\\1)");
        std::sregex_token_iterator it(s.begin(), s.end(), re, -1);
        std::sregex_token_iterator end;
        for (; it != end; ++it) {
            std::string run = it->str();
            if ((run.length() & 1) == 0) {
                count++;
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
